Start a capsule from a template

Source: R/capsule_template.R
usecpstmpl.Rd

Creates a new folder with the three files a reproducible analysis "capsule" needs, ready to be filled in: a data_provenance.json that says where the data come from, an analysis.R script that fetches, checks, analyses and records, and a README.md that says how to run it. Use it to start a new project in the package's fetch-verify-analyse-record pattern instead of writing that scaffolding by hand.

Usage

usecpstmpl(path, name = basename(path), ex = FALSE)

Arguments

path

Character string: the directory to create. It may exist only if it is empty.

name

Character string: the capsule name written into the provenance and README. Defaults to the last part of path.

ex

Logical, default FALSE. TRUE uses the shipped OTIS table as the source so the skeleton runs immediately; FALSE leaves a TODO URL.

Value

The directory path, invisibly.

Details

The files:

data_provenance.json

the fields loadprov and vrfcps expect: name, source (url, publisher, licence, retrieved, sha256) and table (value, period, by, rounding, suplim). Every field that must be filled in is marked TODO.

analysis.R

reads the provenance, downloads the source with fdl (a local path is read directly), computes its SHA-256 with sha256file and stops if it no longer matches the pinned value, runs anltab, and writes manifest.json, report.html and report.md in results/.

README.md

the three steps to fill in and run the capsule.

With example = TRUE the source is the OTIS table otis_a01_individuals.csv shipped in the package's extdata folder, so Rscript analysis.R runs as written. The table settings in the template (value = "individuals", period = "year", by = c("table", "group")) fit that example and must be edited for other data.

Side effects: creates path (and its parents) and writes the three files. Errors: path exists and is not empty; name is not a single non-empty string. The name and source are written as escaped JSON strings, so quotes and backslashes are safe.

See also

loadprov, vrfcps, anltab.

Examples

d <- usecpstmpl(tempfile("capsule-"), ex = TRUE)
list.files(d)
#> [1] "README.md"            "analysis.R"           "data_provenance.json"

# the provenance file to fill in
cat(readLines(file.path(d, "data_provenance.json")), sep = "\n")
#> {
#>   "name": "capsule-1e105239f467",
#>   "source": {
#>     "url": "/tmp/RtmpQgzlZ3/temp_libpath1e107c356c2a/rmoriebricklayer/extdata/otis_a01_individuals.csv",
#>     "publisher": "TODO: who publishes the table",
#>     "licence": "TODO: e.g. Open Government Licence - Ontario",
#>     "retrieved": "TODO: YYYY-MM-DD",
#>     "sha256": "TODO: pinned by analysis.R on its first run"
#>   },
#>   "table": {
#>     "value": "individuals",
#>     "period": "year",
#>     "by": ["table", "group"],
#>     "rounding": null,
#>     "suppression_limit": null
#>   }
#> }

# a blank template with a chosen name
d2 <- usecpstmpl(tempfile("capsule-"), name = "segregation-2024")
grep("TODO", readLines(file.path(d2, "data_provenance.json")), value = TRUE)
#> [1] "    \"url\": \"TODO: https://example.org/open-data/table.csv\","   
#> [2] "    \"publisher\": \"TODO: who publishes the table\","             
#> [3] "    \"licence\": \"TODO: e.g. Open Government Licence - Ontario\","
#> [4] "    \"retrieved\": \"TODO: YYYY-MM-DD\","                          
#> [5] "    \"sha256\": \"TODO: pinned by analysis.R on its first run\""   

# an existing, non-empty folder is never overwritten
try(usecpstmpl(d))
#> Error : `path` exists and is not empty
